description.value: Goldie's Donuts & Bakery is a growing Lower Mainland chain specializing in Korean-inspired brioche donuts made with a 24-hour slow fermentation process for exceptional texture and flavour. The North Vancouver outpost offers inventive flavours like Matcha Cream and Mango Passion Fruit alongside signature drinks such as a Peanut Butter Cream Latte. Inspired by a golden retriever mascot, the shop aims for a warm, cozy atmosphere and also offers online pre-order pickup.

address.value: 279 East 8th Street, North Vancouver City, V7L1Y9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's Location & Hours page confirms the North Vancouver location at '279 8th St E North Vancouver, British Columbia V7L 1Y9' with phone (604) 770-1599 and email nv@goldiesdonuts.ca, all matching OSM exactly. The website's Order Online section confirms pickup/takeout is available. No website evidence exists for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist amenities.
concerns: OSM name 'Goldie's' is a truncation of the full trading name 'Goldie's Donuts & Bakery' used consistently on the website.
OSM lists the business hours as Mo-Su 07:30-18:30, but the website shows different hours for this location; the OSM hours appear out of date.
OSM tags the location as amenity=cafe, but the business is primarily a donut bakery with specialty drinks — category is broadly correct but the tag understates its bakery nature.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible donut cafe and bakery with confirmed address and contact details. A straightforward stop for touring cyclists wanting food and drinks.
enrichment_extras.notes: Multi-location chain with five Lower Mainland outlets (West Vancouver, Langley, Fraser St Vancouver, North Vancouver, Kitsilano). The North Vancouver location email nv@goldiesdonuts.ca and phone (604) 770-1599 are confirmed by the website.
